name: microgreen-canopy
title: Microgreen Canopy
subtitle: Canopy coverage, greenness, texture uniformity
description: Quantifies dense microgreen canopies: coverage %, greenness index (ExG), texture variance for harvest readiness.
method: HSV hue+saturation → canopy mask → ExG for greenness. No per-plant segmentation (too dense).
dataType: overhead microgreen tray images (dense leafy crop, uniform lighting)

outputs.name: CanopyCover
outputs.label: Canopy coverage
outputs.description: Fraction of tray covered by green foliage

outputs.name: TextureVariance
outputs.label: Texture variance
outputs.description: Uniformity of canopy. Lower = more uniform.

parameters.name: minCover
parameters.label: Minimum coverage %
parameters.description: If below this, harvest not recommended.
